name: com.reromanlee.blockymesher
description: Minecraft-like block landscapes built on the Job System and Burst: an infinite streaming terrain, or standalone block objects like a raft or a house. Smooth colored lighting and prebaked ambient occlusion, light enough for WebGL. URP.

samples.description: Endless hills and caves around a fly camera. Break and place blocks, save and load your edits, and run a day/night cycle that rebuilds no mesh. Needs the Input System package.
A standalone landscape made from a block pattern, floating on water with a Rigidbody. Edit it with the mouse and launch copies of it. Needs the Input System package.
